title: Agreement between large language models and human coders on psychological and clinical text: data and code
description: Records, decisions, coded data and analysis code for a registered systematic review and multilevel meta-analysis of agreement between generative large language models and human coders on psychological and clinical text (search 21 October 2026, citation searching 23 October 2026; 377 studies, 416 reports; 107 studies with 595 kappa-family estimates). The repository includes the protocol and deviations log, search logs and records, two AI screening passes with the reviewer's blind calibration and decisions, AI full-text proposals with the reviewer's decisions, the coded drafts with the reviewer's review applied as code, the analysis tables, R and Python analysis scripts, results, figures, Tables 1-4 and Supplementary Files S1-S6.
